concerns.analysis: The source PDF contains several meaningful instructional icons embedded directly into text steps. Many of these are missing entirely from the HTML output, resulting in broken instructions. For example, the 'edit' icon on page 3 is absent, and the '+' icon on page 2 step 7 is also missing.
concerns.source_pdf_quote: Page 3 step 2: "In your profile page, click on [Edit Icon] next to your email."
concerns.output_quote: • In your profile page, click on next to your email.

concerns.analysis: The source PDF contains continuous numbered lists (e.g., 1 through 9 on Page 2, and 1 through 5 on Page 4). In the output JSON, these continuous ordered lists are fragmented into multiple separate list objects broken apart by images. As a result, the numbering will restart at '1' multiple times in the HTML render (e.g., Step 5 and Step 8 on Page 2 are placed as the sole items inside new list objects, causing them to render as '1').
concerns.source_pdf_quote: Numbered list from 1 to 9 (e.g., "5. Select 'Authenticator' and click:", "8. Click on the 'Scan QR Code'...")
concerns.output_quote: The list is broken into 6 separate ordered lists. For example, {"type": "list", "list_type": "ordered", "items": [{"text": "Select \u201cAuthenticator\u201d and click:"}]}

concerns.description: Images placed next to wrong text
concerns.analysis: When instructional images and buttons do appear in the HTML, they are frequently stripped from their inline contexts and grouped at the end of lists, removing them from the text they illustrate. For instance, on page 5, the trash can icon belongs in step 3 but is pushed to the bottom of the list after step 4.
concerns.source_pdf_quote: Page 5 step 3 reads "3. Click on [Trash Icon] next to the method you want to delete."
concerns.output_quote:
The HTML reads "
  • Click on next to the method you want to delete.
    • " in step 3, and places the trash can icon () after step 4.

concerns.description: Header/footer elements retained in output (4): MyNCID User Guide * Ver 1.3; December 10th, 2025; Page 1 of 6
concerns.analysis: header_footer_count=4. Running headers/footers/page numbers should be stripped during PDF-to-HTML conversion.

concerns.description: Only 1/9 (11%) of source hyperlinks preserved in output
concerns.analysis: source_link_count=9, output_link_count=1, link_count_ratio=0.11. Most PDF URI annotations were lost during extraction.

concerns.description: List numbering restart(s): 7 ordered list(s) restart numbering at 1 instead of continuing sequence
concerns.analysis: restart_count=7. Examples: p2: 4 single-item ordered lists (fragmented); p4: 5 single-item ordered lists (fragmented). Ordered lists that restart numbering suggest content was split across page breaks and not reassembled.

Some specific text formatting meant to emphasize key UI terms is lost in the conversion. In the step-by-step instructions on page 6, the specific options to select are bolded to aid quick scanning, but this bolding is absent in the HTML.
concerns.source_pdf_quote: Page 6 step 2: "you will get the following options: Authenticator, or email." (with 'Authenticator, or email.' in bold text)
concerns.output_quote: you will get the following options: Authenticator, or email. (rendered as plain unstyled text without <b> or <strong> tags)
concerns.location: Enroll MFA via an application section (Page 6), step 2

concerns.description: Repeated footer/header text (5x): "myncid user guide for mfa"
concerns.analysis: Short text block appears on 5/6 pages

concerns.description: Displaced hyperlinks: 1 link(s) extracted as standalone elements instead of inline text
concerns.analysis: standalone_links=1, examples=['https://myncid.nc.gov/']. Links should be inline within paragraphs, not separate blocks.

concerns.description: 1 bare URL(s) in text not converted to hyperlinks: https://myncid.nc.gov/
concerns.analysis: bare_url_count=1. URLs appear as plain text instead of clickable links.
